verdicts.reason: A drops the hero photo of praying hands down to a meaningless black sliver jammed against the top edge, and the faint plus marks at the right edge are leftover debris. It does give the quote a clean, readable two-column banner (quote left, MAHATMA GANDHI right), though the bottom half is dead space. B also shrinks the photo to a tiny thumbnail and leaves broken fragments: ghostly white cloud outlines and a row of plus signs float on the left. The author line sits right under the quote with no separation, and the right side is empty, so the layout is lopsided.
